The Hidden Opponent ©️ on Instagram: "Lauren Betts: Mental Health Champion ➡️ NCAA Champion 👑

Today, Lauren Betts led the UCLA Bruins to the program’s first ever NCAA National Championship, where she was also named the Tournament’s Most Outstanding Player. She finishes her dominant college career with multiple personal accolades, including 2x All-American, Defensive Player of the Year, and UCLA’s all-time leader in blocks. 

Two weeks ago, Lauren published a touching personal essay in @playerstribune detailing her struggle with depression, titled “I Want To Be Here.” 

She vulnerably shared about body image, pressure to perform, and an extended hospital stay for her mental health. When she returned to basketball, her coaches and teammates met her with open arms. She also credits therapy for helping build her back up. 

Lauren ended her Players’ Tribune piece with “Now, I’m playing free and with joy. No matter where I go from here, I know I’ve come a long way. And for that, I feel extremely brave.”

And for that, Lauren, we are grateful to have witnessed your journey. Congratulations, and thank you. 💚

#marchmadness #womensbasketball #laurenbetts #ucla"

For 35 years I experienced treatment resistant depression. Medications, psychotherapy, shock treatments- nothing alleviated the disease. 12 years ago I participated in a clinical trial of brain surgery to insert a brain stimulator.
